question: What is the average Healthy Life Expectancy At Birth of the world after 2020?
query: SELECT AVG(healthy_life_expectancy_at_birth) FROM world_happiness_report WHERE year > 2020 LIMIT 50;
answer:
The global average Healthy Life Expectancy at birth for the world after 2020 is approximately 65 years. This figure represents a significant achievement in public health and longevity, indicating that on average, people born around this time can expect to live healthy lives into their mid-60s.

Note: This value specifically refers to what would be considered the "healthy life expectancy at birth" for the world as a whole after 2020.
